name: auth-failure
description: A rejected credential: the JWS validator answers 401 to the first device request. The run must end cleanly with zero assets and a printed diagnostic rather than aborting, and it must not keep hammering the endpoint -- 401 is not a retried status, so exactly one request is made.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.
